Dear Litware Team,

Thank you for bringing the seat billing discrepancy to our attention. We’ve processed a **goodwill refund of 120 units** to address the historical overcharge, even though your current contract reflects the correct seat allocation.

This resolves the issue on our end. If you have further questions, reply to this email.

Best regards,
IT Operations Team
